files.content: 4 tests (1 host + 3 GPU #[ignore]): shadow-on exact-recipe criteria, shadow-off bitwise pre-unlock regression, visibility control, reference parsing
minimal read-only npz reader (ZIP_STORED + npy v1.0, no npz dependency) for capture-exact references + frozen sha256 assertions + reference-level difference counters
scene-shadow product scene assembly (fields_from_model + light_castshadow=[1,1,1]) + comparison/assertion/run hash helpers

tests.host_result: 1 passed; 0 failed; 3 ignored (after reference switch; frozen sha assertions on capture-exact pass)

fast_math_group.note: kept as history and cross-recipe diagnostics only; its difference to the exact recipe is recorded in docs/development-evidence/render-bvh/r09-s3a-capture-exact/

capture_exact_cross_checks.note: executed in the capture-exact window (CPU read-only) and recorded in that task's evidence

criteria.shadow_on: product nworld=1 + scene-shadow + use_shadows=true vs capture-exact/shadow-on (same recipe): RGB per-channel <= 1 LSB, depth <= 4 ULP (bit-exact mismatched==0 preferred), seg exact; two runs sha256 identical (rgb/depth/seg)
criteria.shadow_off_1: vs capture-exact/shadow-off (same recipe): same criteria as shadow-on
criteria.shadow_off_2: bitwise regression to pre-unlock same-recipe product reference: depth/seg vs s7b1::RECIPE_REFERENCE mismatched==0/max_ulp 0; RGB vs s7b2::parse_rgb_fast_math_false_reference() max_byte_diff==0 (S8 pre-unlock measured 0)
criteria.visibility_control: semantic cross-check only: product shadow-on vs shadow-off difference pixel counts alongside reference-level counts; asserts product depth/seg do not change with use_shadows and RGB must change; no equivalence/precision conclusion

runner.behavior: 5 s monitor until 60 consecutive clean samples; guard precheck (util<40 x3, free>=10240); 9 entities serially with --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture; 0.25 s continuous sampler (abort util>=80 x3); 3-point baseline; floor=min(10240, baseline_free-3072); zero Rust compile verified via deps snapshot; post-window 9/9 exe sha recheck

s2b_unlock_assertions_must_run.requirement: must actually execute the 'use_shadows=true -> accepted -> Ok(())' assertion inside the window; runner greps the entity log for the case ok line and the success marker, records shadows_acceptance_<entity> in facts, and fails when missing

window_requirements.sampler: 0.25 s continuous sampler required for device-verification windows
window_requirements.window_discipline: prebuilt frozen 9 exes, compute-apps filtered 0, attempt=1, at most 2 valid rounds, post-window 9/9 recheck

limitations: authoring stage only: no GPU test has been executed and no window verdict is made
no rendering numeric conclusion; the fast-math capture group is not part of any assertion (history/diagnostics only)
if shadow-off bitwise regression fails inside the window (depth/seg mismatched!=0 or RGB max_byte_diff!=0) the work stops and reports to Arch; criteria are not relaxed
if shadow-on versus the capture-exact reference exceeds criteria inside the window, results are recorded as-is and handled by Arch/Chief decision; criteria are not relaxed
references and fixtures remain read-only; no .gitattributes change

gates.normify_gate_note: authoring-stage gates ran on the in_progress commit tree (61b82f9a); after the reference switch the gates must be re-run on the final tree at closure (records under .normify/runs/2026-10-28-render-bvh-r09-s3b-shadow-validation/)
